name: Relief for Energy Assistance through Community Help (REACH)
description: Up to $800 energy credit for past-due bills for income-eligible customers who received a 15-day or 48-hour disconnection notice; once per calendar year
fullDescription: The REACH program provides emergency bill assistance for PG&E customers facing disconnection, offering up to $800 to help income-eligible households avoid losing power or gas service.
whatTheyOffer:
- Up to $800 energy bill credit toward past-due charges
- Helps prevent service disconnection
- For customers who received a shutoff notice
- Available once per calendar year
- Credit goes directly to your PG&E bill
- First-come, first-served while funding lasts
howToGetIt:
1. Must be income-eligible (up to 200% federal poverty level)
2. Must be the customer of record and have received a 15-day or 48-hour disconnection notice
3. Apply online through Dollar Energy Fund (myappconnect.com/pge) or call for help with the form
4. Customers enrolled in the Arrearage Management Plan (AMP) are not eligible
5. Credit applied directly to your PG&E account
keywords: REACH, PG&E, emergency, disconnection, shutoff, utility bill, low-income, bill assistance, $800, Dollar Energy Fund
